description: Defines an interface for requests to clear (anonymize) the profile of the authenticated user. Clearing a profile requires the user to have two factor authentication enabled and is performed in two steps: a ClearProfileRequest, which is answered with a 401 including a twoFaToken, followed by a ClearProfileWithTwoFactorAuthToken.

concreteType.description: Indicates which implementation of ClearProfileInterface this object represents. Valid Values: org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.auth.ClearProfileRequest org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.auth.ClearProfileWithTwoFactorAuthToken
